products.note: Meeting analytics AI; engagement scoring; wellness insights; behavioral data privacy

profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as the fastest growing AI meeting assistant, offering real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across meetings, messages, emails, CRM systems, and documents. Its site positions the product as a platform-agnostic AI copilot that works across tools to deliver unified insights on any device.

The company's primary product, Read.ai, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and includes meeting analytics, engagement scoring, wellness insights, and behavioral data privacy features. The site emphasizes that Read.ai connects across third-party platforms rather than being tied to any single environment, drawing on integrated content and context to power its AI capabilities.

The held facts record no litigation, MCP server presence, or SEC or patent filings associated with Read at this time.
